data.long_meaning: The name Roslyn is derived from Old English roots ‘ros’ meaning rose and ‘lyn’ meaning valley or hollow. The name evokes images of a peaceful and beautiful valley filled with roses. This name was popular during the Middle Ages and has been used in literature and poetry throughout history.
